focus: The newsroom is publishing again after six quiet days, and the site now explains itself better when it cannot publish: a scan that finds nothing worth writing about says exactly why. The desk also refused an easy fix that would have let it claim two outlets agreed when they had not.
nextStep: Keep widening the set of publications the desk can actually read, since that is now what limits how often it can write. Account verification remains on its separate approval path.

decisions.note: Expose a small deterministic mobile cohort and re-check close mix.
Refresh RUM UX ingestion before treating zero or low conversion as visitor behaviour.
Flip strict only after field p75 is sufficient and healthy.
Route top themes into feedback decision board lanes.
